_about: Shared fixture of the hard/soft class a '❓ Blocking @person' ask arms its human gate with, and the default the ask itself states (server markerDefault, Runner asks.marker_default): on the marker line or after it, never above. Byte-identical copies live in evc-mesh internal/service/testdata/ask_class_cases.json and evc-mesh-runner tests/fixtures/ask_class_cases.json. The Go test (markerGateClass) and the Python test (asks.gate_class) both assert every case, and that their hard_patterns, hard_labels and fallback_default equal the ones here. To change either side: change this file, copy it to the other repo, make both tests pass.
fallback_default: применить рекомендацию исполнителя / закрыть как есть
